posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body:
The international RPG Maker MV version of the Brazilian's
RPG Maker 2003 classic:
Fantasya Final Definitiva REMAKE!
​
Synopsis
Samuka, a former noble and skilled samurai from Kaganumato Island, ventures through the world indefinitely after a pub to drink out his misadventures without knowing that the future of Earth, and even the good sake of Time-Space continuum, lays at his hands.
Later, a stray dog, an orphaned martian and a madhouse escapee join his party to journey alongside him through the past and the future on this epic nonsense adventure.
Anew Fantasy
is both a parody to shabby made RPG Maker games and homage to old classics of the 16-bit J-RPG era that have won the heart of many generations of players around the globe.
Characters
Samuka - The Silent Protagonist
The main hero of this adventure. Has a natural talent to see himself in trouble and his only goal in life is to find a neat place to drink in peace.
Fido - The Stray Dog
Becomes the best friend of Samuka and follow him up wherever he goes.
E.T. - The Orphaned Martian
Tags along with Samuka and Fido after being rescued by them.
Matey - Madhouse Escapee
He used to be a pirate. Driven mad after a traumatic experience with the fabled Kraken, he wants to prove that the creature exists at all costs.
Mechanics
The game follows up the basic gameplay of classic RPGs, except that you will see some skills (a.k.a. Magic) which can be learned through what are know to be "magballs" (a parody to the Materia system). Magballs affects the skills you can use and also alters base stats, greatly influencing game play during combat.
